claims.statement: Section H named-row eligibility is the conjunction of exactly one accepted same-scope certificate for each of eleven written gate coordinates.
claims.falsifier: an accepted bundle missing, failing, duplicating, or inventing a gate
claims.forbidden: this theorem supplies any family gate

claims.statement: Gate certificates at incompatible scopes cannot be glued without a registered transport theorem.
claims.scope: scope tuple of family row, grammar, ecology, budget, freeze, and protected interface
claims.falsifier: accepting one certificate whose scope differs from the target
claims.forbidden: scope transport is impossible in principle

claims.statement: Every finite binary observation prefix has two total continuations agreeing on the prefix and disagreeing at the first unobserved point.
claims.falsifier: a prefix for which the explicit pair is not total, disagrees inside the prefix, or agrees at the next point
claims.forbidden: finite-to-real-scale transfer is impossible after adding assumptions or evidence

claims.statement: A one-state and a distinct two-state organization have identical protected response profiles on every finite binary word.
claims.falsifier: a finite binary word whose output traces differ
claims.forbidden: all family identities are observationally unknowable under richer interfaces
